component.name: SnapCanvas
component.summary: Publication-ready screenshots with privacy and OCR

description.p: SnapCanvas is an all-in-one, privacy-first desktop screenshot suite designed for professionals, support teams, developers, accountants, and creators. It combines fast capture, professional framing, rich annotations, on-device OCR, automatic sensitive data redaction, and flexible file uploading into a single workflow.

ul.li: Automatic detection and masking of sensitive data: emails, IBAN bank accounts, tax IDs (VAT / NIP), national IDs, credit card numbers, and phone numbers.
Choose between Blur, Noise, or Blackout redaction styles before sharing.
Local-by-default architecture: OCR and redaction engines run entirely offline on your computer.
Optional Local-Only Mode cuts off external network calls completely.
Ephemeral clipboard support to auto-clear copied screenshots after 60 seconds.
Precise region capture, window selection, full screen, and multi-monitor stitching.
Configurable delay timer (0 to 10 seconds) for capturing menus, tooltips, and hover states.
Global shortcuts and system tray actions for quick access.
Transform raw screenshots into clean, branded visuals for documentation, bug reports, and social media.
Control padding, corner radius, drop shadows, aspect ratios (16:9, 1:1, Story, Social), and custom backgrounds or gradients.
Watermark support (text and logo) and reusable custom framing presets.
Arrows, lines, geometric shapes, freehand pen, and highlighters.
Step-by-step numbered callouts and customizable text boxes.
Non-destructive layers with full undo/redo and cropping handles.
Built-in offline OCR text extraction (supports English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Italian).
Click any detected word to copy or drag to select multi-word ranges.
Automatic QR code detection: open links or copy decoded text instantly.
Instant clipboard copy with all layers preserved.
Save to disk (PNG, JPEG, WebP) with configurable naming templates.
Built-in upload support: transfer images directly to your own FTP/SFTP server, Amazon S3 bucket, or public hosting providers.

description.p: Publication-ready screenshots with privacy, OCR, and smart redaction.
